s = z3.Solver()

# 1. No K4: for every set of 4 vertices, at least one edge is absent
for quad in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    s.add(z3.Not(z3.And([e[(quad[a], quad[b])] for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(4),2)])))
